about_the_game:
Characters

Luvina

The daughter of the Great Pirate. After 10 years of saving money from menial jobs, she earned

enough for the small sailing ship she always wanted.

To restore her father's honor, she goes in search of the Artemis Pearl,

a hidden treasure he once possessed.

She is very guarded.

Styria

A captain of the chivalric order, who seek to suppress pirates. Though a noble knight, she is a realist who will do

whatever it takes to achieve her goals.

Has few quibbles regarding sex.

Fully animated

Pose art and H Scenes are animated!

Before penetration -> After penetration -> Thrusting -> Ejaculation

plus more variations are all animated!

Features

- Old-fashioned RPG

- Collect items from the field and strengthen your equipment.

- Build up your pirate ship and explore the map.

- Scout characters and strengthen your team.

- Take on the bounty hunters and get huge rewards!
